responsibility: Implements the generic x86 target hooks used by the D front end. It adds D predefined version identifiers for 32-bit versus 64-bit/x32 x86 and hard-float versus soft-float modes, answers D target-info queries such as floatAbi and objectFormat from x86 backend state, and reports stdcall availability and linker-convention flags based on the active x86 ABI, making it the architecture-level D adaptation layer separate from OS-specific D files like cygwin-d.cc.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-d.h, which only declares and wires up the D target hooks, this file implements the x86-side D frontend behavior: builtin version selection, target-info query handlers, and stdcall-convention reporting.
